selection: seeded shuffle of the resolution-qualified pool; the first k candidates whose downloaded bytes pass the resolution gate are accepted, canonicalized by (observation_id, photo_id)

resolution_gate.pool_filter: API photo URL must end with /square.jpg (only that convention has a medium rendition in the bucket)
resolution_gate.replacement_policy: next candidate in the same seeded order
resolution_gate.defect_repaired: the first Phase A fetch rewrote square.jpg -> medium.jpg case-sensitively, so 198/432 photos were stored as 75x75 thumbnails (square.JPG/.jpeg/.png have no medium object)
